name: Tulsi (Holy Basil)
preparation: Leaves used fresh or as a decoction (kadha).
precautions: Educational information only. Consult a qualified practitioner before use.

name: Neem
preparation: Leaf paste for topical use; twigs traditionally used for dental care.
precautions: Educational information only. Consult a qualified practitioner before use.

name: Ashwagandha
preparation: Root powder (churna), traditionally taken with milk.
precautions: Educational information only. Consult a qualified practitioner before use.

name: Arjun
preparation: Stem bark traditionally used as a powder or decoction (kwatha).
precautions: Educational information only. Consult a qualified practitioner before use, especially if you have a heart condition or take heart medication.

name: Curry Leaf
preparation: Fresh leaves used in food; also used as a paste or infusion in traditional practice.
precautions: Educational information only. Consult a qualified practitioner before medicinal use.

name: Kalanchoe
preparation: Fresh leaf juice or poultice in traditional practice.
precautions: Educational information only. Consult a qualified practitioner before use. Not for use in pregnancy, and can be harmful to pets.

name: Mint
preparation: Fresh leaves as an infusion, chutney, or juice.
precautions: Educational information only. Consult a qualified practitioner before medicinal use.
